subject: Trading
title: Maximum Drawdown
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Maximum Drawdown.

hook.text: Your account peaked at $50,000 and fell to $35,000. That 30% decline is your maximum drawdown—and it measures pain.

buildup.text: Maximum drawdown is the largest peak-to-trough decline in your account history. It's the worst-case scenario so far.

discovery.text: Professional funds report max drawdown alongside returns. A 20% annual return with 50% max drawdown is terrifying.

twist.text: Your future max drawdown will likely be worse than your historical one. Plan for it to be 50-100% larger.

climax.text: If you can't psychologically survive your strategy's expected max drawdown, you'll quit at the worst time.

punchline.text: Know the worst before it happens.

quiz.question: What is maximum drawdown?
options: The largest peak-to-trough decline in portfolio value
